# Example: if Statement

#### Course: Learn C Programming

## Example: if Statement

```c
1// Check whether a student passed or failed the exam.
2// We will assume the passing score is 50 or above.
3
4#include <stdio.h>
5
6int main() {
7
8    int score;
9  
10    // Get student score from the user
11    printf("Enter score: ");
12    scanf("%d", &score);
13
14    // Print pass message if score is 50 or above
15    if (score >= 50) {
16        printf("Congratulations!\n");
17        printf("You passed the examination.");
18    }
19  
20    return 0;
21}
```

Sample Output 1

```text
Enter score: 72
Congratulations!
You passed the examination.
```

If the user enters 72, score >= 50 in the if statement will be 1 (true). In this case, the statements inside the if statement are executed.

Sample Output 2

```text
Enter score: 42
```

If the user enters 35, score >= 50 in the if statement will be 0 (false). In this case, the statements inside the if statement are skipped from execution.
